observations: Photo 0 shows a television displaying a PlayStation 5 user interface.
The UI shows icons for Astro's Playroom, FC25, FC26, Grand Theft Auto V, Mortal Kombat 1, and Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection.
The text 'Console storage: 8' is visible in the top left of the UI, which is not standard for a PS5.
A white PlayStation 5 console is positioned below the TV; it features the horizontal slit and side bulge of the Slim Disc Edition.
A black DualSense controller is placed in front of the console.
A watermark 'JAYCYPHER GAMES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' appears across the images.
Photo 2 provides a close-up of the console and controller, showing a clean exterior.

claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 2 show the console and controller in clean condition.
Photo 2 shows the split-plate design of the PS5 Slim model.
EA Sports FC 26 does not exist; the icon in photo 0 is a digital fabrication.
FC 25 is not yet released; the icon in photo 0 is likely a digital fabrication.

risks.proof: A continuous video of the console booting up, navigating the menu, and launching a game to prove the UI is real.
Video of the games being launched while the console is logged into a different user account.
Video showing the console successfully connecting to the PlayStation Store.

proof_requests: A video of the console being turned on and navigating the 'Settings > Storage' menu.
A photo of the model and serial number sticker on the bottom/back of the console.
A video of the console launching one of the claimed games.
response.reason: The photos show icons for 'FC25' and 'FC26'. EA Sports FC 26 does not exist, and FC 25 has not been released. The presence of these icons, along with non-standard UI text ('Console storage: 8'), indicates the images have been digitally altered, which is a clear sign of a scam.
